import os

import argparse
import json
import random
import numpy as np
import torch

from src.config import Config
from src.pipeline import run_recursive_training


CONDITION_CHOICES = ["pure_collapse", "fixed_mix", "linear_increasing", "adaptive"]
CHECKPOINT_BASE = "/root/autodl-tmp/spectral_collapse_ews/checkpoints_phase1"
RESULTS_DIR = "/root/spectral_collapse_ews/results"

def set_seed(seed):
    """Set all random seeds for reproducibility."""
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)

def parse_args():

        config.controller_signal_mode = args.signal_mode
        ratio_schedule = None

    return config, ratio_schedule

    args = parse_args()
    set_seed(args.seed)
